item.title: Phantom Entry
item.description: An anomalous Security Containment Procedure entry in the foundation's database, suddenly appearing out of nowhere.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: No

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror, Emotional, Comedy, Mystery

Page Layout: Standard

Elevator Pitch: An SCP entry about an anomalous SCP entry.

Central Narrative: Out of nowhere, a new fully authorized SCP entry has appeared randomly in the Foundation's database, where it describes an entity so foreign and alien to the current local reality, where any and all sophisticated informational stimuli regarding it cannot be transcribed and comprehended when unaided, resulting in the immediate loss of said information after it removes its presence, such as memory. Translations, however, are perfectly comprehensible, such as written or recorded materials. However, it may also be corrupted if said entity acts upon it. The entity refers to itself in the English language as "Your Warden" or "Them", a being that proclaimed itself as the safe keeper of all reality from itself, by destroying realities beyond repair, and cleaning those near broken. However, even with all the SCP shenanigans, the time it spent observing the world(s) in this local reality had changed its mind, and coming to the absurd conclusion that the SCP universe may be the most convoluted, but it is far from broken, and everything belongs, resulting in its departure leaving this reality to its own business.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The mass confusion where absolutely no one remembers anything regarding the Security Containment Procedure ever transpiring adds to the curiosity of the reader, and it also enjoys the treatment of a drastic mood change, it slowly shifts from being a lighthearted slice of life reality hopping Mary Sue into a dreadful, cosmic horror-esque atmosphere. The horror will be mostly informational horror, the feeling of dread when presented absurd consensuses and information. There's just too much out there, and you have no say over it. The struggle to understand will lead to hatred, fear, confusion, denial, and much more will be explored.

item.title: SCP-6285 - The Putrefaction - Seeking Greenlit
item.description: A contagious fungus that is able to raise the dead.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror, Action, Drama

Elevator Pitch:

+) It is a contagious fungus that is capable of raising the dead, then after a particular time, the now living dead will grow extra sharp bones out of their body, particularly the limbs. The reason being that having sharp "weapons" is the most useful way for SCP-6285-1 (The corpses) to kill other living humans which spreads the infection even further. The fungus shoots out spores and coming into contact with human corpses will begin to reanimate them. If there is a living human around there, it will attach to them as transportation without them knowing.

+) The unpredictable neverending evolution and mutation of the fungus is what makes it so deadly. This means SCP-6285-1 can have limitless potential and growth to serve the fungus's purpose.

+) SCP-6285-1 also has an invisible gooey substance which helps to patch its wounds if necessary. Using extreme heat is the best way to neutralize it.

Central Narrative: It should be from going normal, peaceful to a hell hole. At first, the SCP seems harmless and all, as time goes by, the horror and dreadfulness of it will soon come cause of how infectious it can spread and fast reanimation

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The Putrefaction is unique in terms of reanimating the dead if this is a thing. To be honest, I was inspired by the Necromorphs in Dead Space to that the host growing extra limbs because it is the most helpful tactic to rank up more kills for the fungus to raise an army. The terrifying existence of the fungus can cause human extinction.

item.title: SCP IDEA: "Smart Nut"
item.description: Idea for an SCP that is an anomalous almond. Title/name of SCP is a work in progress.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: An almond that grants the eater boosted brain function with side effects.

Central Narrative: An almond that allows the consumer a boosted brain function. Boosted brain function means able to recall memories in better detail, more of them, think faster. Also have boosted energy levels that allow this extreme thinking to happen. Think of the show Limitless on Netflix. Side effects would include headaches, restlessness, hallucinations of another oneself that you can talk to and bounce ideas off of. Almond contains extra cyanide that may be the cause of side effects.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Stephen Hawking is though to have taken this Almond consistently before it was taken by the SCP foundation. Might be cause of his development of ALS.

Additional Notes: This is my first SCP I'm writing and I've done some research. Need critiques on how to expand on the idea I have for an SCP

item.title: SCP IDEA: "Home"
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A sentient Siberian town wants all who come across it to never leave.

Central Narrative: The SCP is a small village in Siberia. The village is populated by human-like creatures. The longer you stay in the village the more it starts to figure out your personality. It will slowly form itself to fit your ideal town. As time goes on the village is almost like a paradise for you. If you try to leave the people in the village will take you to a room and turn you into one of them. If you don't try to leave you slowly transform and become one of the people there. Basically, the village doesn't want you to leave. It learns about you to keep you from leaving.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The town consumes all who come across it and turns them into the people who inhabit the town.

item.title: {Seeking Greenlight} The Devil You Know
item.description: Better than the devil you don't.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Weird

Elevator Pitch: This creature resembles a demonic humanoid borne from human consciousness with a key anomaly embedded in its infectious presence. Anyone that either directly observes it or indirectly through secondhand description becomes convinced them to be a long-forgotten friend or lover they remember fondly, regardless whether said witnesses has any actual history with subject.

Subject also possesses the ability to instantly teleport close by to anyone familiar with the entity’s existence, manifesting instantaneously around corners or behind doors. Whenever someone becomes informed about this creature, that person is immediately “marked” as a potential anchor destination for teleportation.

+ show block
– hide block

Individuals who become more familiar with the subject heavily favors its opinion over even their closest peers, occupying their minds to near obsession. Individuals experiencing excess time spent in its presence become entirely occupied by thoughts of the entity, abandoning loved ones, and even disregarding basic needs like food or shelter in more extreme cases.

The most notable and bizarre feature to this process, however, is that continued exposure to the demon’s anomalous presence is capable of erasing of any pre-existing mental manipulative affects placed upon any human’s psyche. Intervals of necessary exposure to the demon’s presence to perform this varies from days to years, depending on how powerful said previous manipulative alterations were. This property may indeed prove valuable to the foundation, though anyone proven to acknowledge devil's existence from both direct or indirect sources can only be remedied with large doses of Class A amnestic.

Central Narrative: The demon was borne out of an unknown man’s own sacrifice to ritualistically create something from the collective unconscious of humanity. Subject finds mild entertainment in playing with the strings of the human mind it has such a great intuitive understanding about, preferring to use his powers to minimize aggression in his presence. It holds little empathy for humanity, though its indifference allows rare opportunities for it to cooperate with something that might grapple its attention; typically whatever may, in the subject’s words, “make these mundane hours more interesting.”

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The devil can be dangerous due to its powerful and evocative aura and teleportative capabilities, but it can also be utilized to counteract active influence mind-affecting SCP creatures.

Tags: compulsion, empathetic, humanoid, infohazard, mind-affecting, keter, sapient, sentient, teleportation

item.title: First SCP.
item.description: A polish immigrant who runs a butchershop and deli is secretly a Sarkite who uses his powers to make the best meat around.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A well liked butcher in the area turns out to be empowered by the power of the flesh to produce the best cuts.

Central Narrative: A story of a Polish sarkite who flees his community during the chaos at the end of WWI and emigrates to America for a normal life. He finds work running a butcher shop and deli. He's able to do this by cloning beef and pork and manipulating it to be the best possible cut of meat to work with. This causes him to be popular and wealthy as he doesn't need to keep buying new meat. It does cause people to spread rumors about mob ties as he sometimes talks to scary looking men who aren't from the area. He dies and tells his son to not get involved in sarkicism, that the UIU and Foundation will deal with any problems about it, and that he' a good enough butcher to not need flesh warping powers.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Turns out the butcher who everyone thinks has mob ties and might be a cannibal is actually neither. Though the truth isn't all that comforting

Additional Notes: This is my second idea for my first SCP. The basic feed back from my first try a few weeks ago basically boiled down to it being too similar to another SCP and not very narrative. So I put that idea on the back burner and came up with something I thought would be more narrative.

item.title: Snatcher Slug (Seeking Critique)
item.description: My first SCP, currently seeking critique and maybe a greenlight, but not quite yet.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Not yet

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is an SCP that can attach itself to a host, designated SCP-XXXX-1, in the form of a small slug that slowly feeds off of its host until the host is completely alone from anyone else and is isolated somewhere where it can not be detected killing them. It then pumps a potent, instantly acting neurotoxin into their bloodstream and assimilates as them, eating them for nutrition. SCP-XXXX then goes around as SCP-XXXX-1, designated as -2 from that point. It releases more small instances of SCP-XXXX that repeat the process, and after a period of two years, -2 dies. SCP-XXXX can infect any sufficiently complex organism, and inherits all abilities of that organism. It has been observed assimilating with dogs, cats, and even a juvenile Kokomo dragon. A definite way to detect -2 is to take a Copper or Gold wire heated to at least 15° Celsius and submerge it lightly in a blood sample of -2. When the wire touches the blood, it jumps away. Containing it is somewhat difficult, as it can assimilate into anyone and can not be killed with regular firearms. Instead, to permanently destroy or severely incapacitate it requires using incendiary weaponry. It can survive in pretty much any environment, but to contain it, there is a small room, where over the course of a day, 12 gallons of pig's blood is pumped in for XXXX. The room has 14 different cameras with overlapping sight lines. Past that room is an airlock where there are flamethrower countermeasures installed and infrared scanners to detect the abnormally high body temperature of XXXX.

Central Narrative: A Foundation Research team of twelve researchers are moving to investigate an odd increase in the electromagnetic pulses emanating from the South Pole. They find a large asteroid buried under some ice that seems to have been there for at least 120.000 years, unearthed by melting ice. The team takes back a large canister filled with slugs back to Site-118 for study, but the organisms assimilate with them and manage to destroy the base. MTF Upsilon-6 "Cold Shoulder" (I couldn't find an MTF Squadron with the description I needed so I made one up) attempts to retrieve the scientists, unknowingly bringing back instances of -2 to Site-29, which spreads the infection of XXXX. It is recaptured and contained at Site-29, where the slugs are contained.

item.title: People Seeds
item.description: Inspired by the thought experiment by Judith Jarvis Johnson
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Drama/Emotional

Elevator Pitch: A plant that unpredictably grows on unmarked or secluded graves. The plant then releases seeds that drift through the air and land in a new place. The plant matures into a baby with the exact genetic makeup of the deceased.

Narrative: The plant begins to grow on a site where D-class and other Foundation bodies are disposed of, resurrecting and scattering hundreds of them across the nation. The article then follows the efforts of the Foundation to track down and contain the clones of the people they killed (most of whom have reintegrated into society), robbing them of their second chance. Evidence begins to show that a guilty rogue researcher may have planted the SCP deliberately to resurrect a D-class they were attached to.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A heart-wrenching story of love, loss, reanimation, and what happens when a second chance at life isn't enough.

item.title: The Spider Queen (First SCP)
item.description: The creator of all spiders. Her broken heart has left her with no ill will towards mankind
item.content:encoded:
The creator of all spiders. Her broken heart has left her with no ill will towards mankind left to give. My first attempt at an article.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Not yet.

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: haven't settled on one yet

Elevator Pitch: A Euclid-class queen of spiders that was saddened by humanity's cruelty towards her children to the point where her heart literally cracked. Because of this, she's surprisingly passive. She can make new species of spiders (both normal and anomalous) at will, and spiders flock to her.

Narrative Pitch: Though she has waged several wars against humanity in the past due to the mistreatment of her children that got fiercer as time went on, her heart eventually cracked, flushing all hatred from her body in a single moment. All that was left behind was sorrow.

+ show block
– hide block

Sorrow for her fallen children, and sorrow for sending her children to die in who knows how many wars that they never won. So she packed her things and left the mainland, retreating to an island. Many, many years later, the foundation responds to a radio signal from a battleship claiming that they were being attacked by an enormous spider. It's revealed that she created this spider as a guardian for her personal island that she sends out if she senses that people with bad intentions are coming to her island. The foundation does its thing, making the island as secret as possible while trying to study the spider queen. Eventually, the foundation manages to conduct some interviews with her.

Hook: Aside from the aforementioned interviews, which reveal her backstory, this SCP should be interesting among the other spider-based SCPs that she's not immediately hostile to people. There should also be implications that some of the spider-based SCPs the foundation keeps tabs on are relics of these ancient wars fought by her.

Additional Notes: While she has potential, I want to hear your input for how I could improve her concept.

item.title: Irish Fairies
item.content:encoded:
Irish Fairies, fay creatures that toy and manipulate with humans physically and mentally.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: No.

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Elevator Pitch: The basic idea is that the SCPs are based on Irish fairies, who are (in short) tricksters who manipulate humans in various ways. Whether that be by manipulating their mind to go crazy or manipulating their body to disform them. Fairies were blamed for various things in medieval Ireland, some of those include stuff like schizophrenia or disabilities being 'curses' from fairies. The SCP will differ from generic fairies by being inherently malevolent when the original fairies are not.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: After various missing person reports, and the discovery of a body missing a symmetrical hole in their chest, the Foundation investigate a forest in Ireland. While investigating, one of the team starts hearing voices telling them to kill their teammates and to 'come to the festival' upon telling the team of this the MTF, assuming the SCP has something to do with this, detain and amnestisize the teammate. They leave one MTF to bring the affected teammate out of the forest to safety and continue. After a bit, the MTF see various colorful lights in the distance, and they all begin to hear voices telling them to 'come to the festival'. At this point, the MTF stop broadcasting their video and we are left with only their audio. The captain, who appears to be the least affected, describes what's happening while the others start going mad. Eventually, the captain attempts to flee the situation at which various etheral screaming can be heard before he goes offline.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Well I tried my best to make sure it leaves a lot of questions, and the fact that it's a twist on what is normally considered cute or harmless is pretty interesting.

Additional Notes: I don't know how I feel about the narrative (which is why I'm not seeking a greenlight yet), so I would like critisicm to be focused on that.

item.title: SCP Idea Whale Eating Bird
item.description: A giant bird that hunts whales, based off of the Thunderbird cryptid. My first attempt at an article.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: No, at least not yet.

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre:I haven't settled on one yet, though it will likely be action/suspense.

Layout: Information presentation

Elevator Pitch: A Keter class giant bird, living on an island in the Pacific, hunting whales like an osprey. Unnaturally large and fast, it occasionally attacks human ships.

Central Narrative: The Foundation deploys operatives to the North Pacific after a large bird attacks a group of whale watchers. After some investigation, they are unable to find anything, but stay posted. A few years later, a surfaced Soviet Submarine is sunk by the creature. The Foundation ramps up the search, eventually tracking it to a remote island between Chile and New Zealand. A submarine is sent to drop off a scout crew, but the sub is sunk because they underestimate how deep the creature can dive. A cruiser is deployed, and fires upon the creature when it attempts to dive at it. The bird survives, but the mission is called off to avoid potentially killing it. Another sub is deployed, this time equipped with an improved diving system to get down faster, and more ships surrounding the area to track it by RADAR. The crew treks up the small dormant volcanic island, and finds a nest made of logs with scattered bones. When the RADAR team radios them to say that the bird is returning home, they quickly find that it is coming faster than expected, and the submarine that they arrived on is unable to pick them up. They are forced to spend a night on the island with the bird, but it barely acknowledges them. It is determined that the creature is not a threat, and will be contained simply by baiting it away from coasts and sea lanes.

Hook: The Special Containment Procedure stands out compared to the SCPs I've read. The bird itself isn't dangerous enough to warrant destruction, and generally isolates itself. The Foundation would figure that it's more worthwhile to monitor it, and keep the thing away from humans.

This is my first Article, so I'm a bit nervous about it. Also, I'm aware that there is already a "Thunderbird" Article, but the concept for this one is completely different.

item.title: SCP Proposal: The Red Girl (1st SCP)
item.description: A new humanoid, Euclid-class SCP, which undergoes some dangerous changes
item.content:encoded:
A new humanoid, Euclid-class SCP, which undergoes some dangerous changes when exposed to rage, and might have a connection towards the SCPs Cain and Abel.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX, AKA the Red Girl, is a humanoid anomaly which takes the appearance of a 15-16 year old girl with with long hair and irises in a unnatural shade of bright red. The Red Girl shows usually sweet, affective behavior, but will get triggered if she gets visually or audibly exposed to rage or hatred, or senses rage in a nearby person. SCP-XXXX will undergo a rapid transformation, in which she grows red scales on 60% of her body, will grow claws and fangs and the hair will turn into spikes. SCP-XXXX will then attempt to viciously attack the person that it sensed the anger from, often resulting in a chain reaction if multiple people are nearby, although it will never attack more than 8 people in a row. After the attack, SCP-XXXX will show shock and remorse over its own deeds, and slowly regain her human appearance. Attempts learn SCP-XXXX to control this states have proven ineffective, as the Red Girl seems to lose all memories of the incident within the next 8 hours.

Central Narrative: Although the origins of SCP-XXXX are unbeknownst even to her, Foundation researchers have found one potential clue: on the left shoulder blade, SCP-XXXX bears a tattoo of Sumerian origin, meaning 3 in the original language. This might be a link to SCP-073, who carries a similar mark on his body. Some researchers even started to reference to SCP-XXXX as 'the third sibling', although further research will be necessary before a link can be confirmed.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I want to expand the concepts of SCP-073 and SCP-076. Wouldn't it be interesting to see what would happen if it gets confirmed that Cain and Abel in the SCP universe have a younger sister, who possesses yet another set of anomalous abilities, alongside resemblance in personalities from both brothers?

item.title: The Hungry Constellation
item.description: A shape-shifting constellation that can give anomalous properties
item.content:encoded:
A shape-shifting constellation that can give anomalous properties to whatever it 'eats' based on a two-dimensional perspective from a specific observer

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

The anomaly is a constellation that can take the shape of any Earth-like creature that has a mouth that can be displayed easily in two-dimensions from a perspective, say, a beak. The anomaly is inactive by default, but can be activated for a while if a selected group of people see it, a group which I haven't decided on yet. Once activated, the jaws or beaks or etc. of the constellation closes very slowly, and anything that is 'inside' the jaw relative to the observer from the group of people is destroyed.

In a nutshell, a constellation that gets hungry when a select observer from a group of people sees it.

item.title: The Lost Holiday Special
item.description: Long, long ago, in a video rental store far away...
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: (Joke) SCP

Genre (Optional): Comedy, Weird

Page Layout (Optional): Standard SCP, extensive addenda describing discoveries.

Elevator Pitch: Finally, an answer to where all those Lost Christmas specials come from, where the end up, and why they're all so awful. This extensive research demonstrates both the anomalous nature of their appearance, and offers an occult explanation for their poor quality and untimely release.

Central Narrative: Although the '78 Star Wars special is probably the best known, some paranormal entity has been producing anomalous media since at least 1976. The addenda include selected summaries such as "The 007 Days of Christmas" (1976), "A Very Rocky Christmas" (1979), "The Blues Brothers: A Mission From God" (1998), and "The Festivus Reunion" (2015), all featuring appropriately aged (or decayed) actors reprising their original roles.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Let's be honest. The universe would be a better place if we could blame every holiday special on some unknowable force.

Additional Notes: G. D! B B, A GG C B B A A G.

item.title: The Sandman (GREENLIGHT WANTED)
item.content:encoded:
"It dragged me into my nightmare where it wished for all to feed it's slumbering insanity." Entity inspired by Ole Lukøje.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes
Page Type: SCP Article
Genre (Optional): Horror

Elevator Pitch: A horrific narcolepsy inducing humanoid that can only be seen using UV rays that mutilates people in their dreams to kill them in the real world afterwards.

Central Narrative: On 9/14/15 48-year-old male Christian Andersen was arrested for the gruesome murder and mutilation of his wife and 2 children. “Why did you kill them?” said detective Hawthorne. “I d-didn’t do it, I loved t-them. We-e we’re going to live a hap-ppy l-life. They were the only thing that kept me from ending it all,” Christian managed to say in between sobs. “No more excuses you stupid prick! You’re everything wrong in this world freak!” said detective Hawthorne.

+ show block
– hide block

Just as he was about to speak again, he was spontaneously mutilated which led to the Foundation being alerted of possible anomalous activity in the Østerbro district of Copenhagen, Denmark. After evacuating and securing the district 2 MTF members suddenly fell asleep and upon their awakening, they found themselves in an interrogation room. “What happened lieutenant?” asked doctor. “I suddenly just fell asleep and I was in this place with everything I’ve ever liked but this horrible thing. It mutilated my entire body and I couldn’t flee no matter how hard I tried,” said the MTF lieutenant. “Can you describe what this thing looked like?” questioned the doctor. “It was definitely a humanoid, it had like a split jaw that would allow it to open up its mouth, these weird tubes coming out of its wrists, and -oh god what is this feeling it’s like,” the lieutenant said before his jaw suddenly fell off and it looked like he was trying to mouth the words, “tell my family I love them.” He was spontaneously mutilated.
